Roof fans for smoke control systems (SCS) are installed on the roofs of buildings. They provide direct supply of outdoor air from the rooftop space to stairwells and elevator areas, creating excess pressure in stairwells, elevator shafts, and other zones, preventing smoke from entering these spaces. This simplifies the ventilation system and frees up workspace on the technical floor.
According to SP 7.13130.2013 "Heating, Ventilation, and Air Conditioning. Fire Safety Requirements," the pressure difference at a closed door between a stairwell with supply ventilation and an auxiliary room/corridor should not exceed the maximum minimum value of 20 Pa.
The support system is used to minimize possible dangerous smoke backflow for firefighting and rescue operations. The pressure differential system activates automatically with smoke detectors located on the ceiling of the operating area near the doors leading to the protected area on each floor.
In addition to creating support, another crucial function is compensating for smoke exhaust systems, as removing gas-air mixtures from a sealed space improperly can be dangerous. Supplying air to the lower zone creates a protected space for people and reduces the thermal load from fire products on building structures.

The exhaust air removed from the serviced room flows through every second channel between the plates of the recuperative heat exchanger, heating them (in winter) or cooling them (in summer).
The treated supply air flows through the other channels of the heat exchanger, absorbing heat from the heated plates or cooling down.
INSTALLATION RECOMMENDATIONS.
The heat exchanger can be installed horizontally or vertically.
At the same time, condensate drainage from the exhaust ventilation duct must be ensured. To do this, the corresponding section of the ventilation duct should be inclined at 1 - 3 m, which must be reliably sealed. A branch pipe for condensate drainage should be provided at the lowest point of the duct.
It is also recommended to install a Kanal-KP duct droplet separator on the exhaust side after the heat exchanger.
The direction of air supply - through the heat exchanger or bypassing it to the next section of the supply ventilation system - is regulated by a specific bypass valve, which should be provided separately in the system.

The opening part of the cap is attached to the casing on hinges. The fixation of the opening part of the cap in the closed state is done using locks. The number of necessary hinges and locks is chosen by the manufacturer based on ensuring the rigidity of the structure and the requirements for ensuring tightness (leakage not more than 10 l/(s·m²) and opening force not more than 450 N).
By default, caps are supplied:
from low-alloy steel - with a gray powder coating RAL7004 or RAL7035;
from stainless steel - without coating.

Pressure increase rate: no more than 50 Pa/s
Spatial orientation: only for horizontal sections of networks

list.det:
External closures with louvers type RUZA for weather protection are designed for installation on supply and exhaust openings of ventilation and air conditioning systems to protect the ventilation channel openings and serviced zones from possible adverse external weather impacts.
Such closures with louvers are installed on saturation parts in the cuts of hull structures of ventilation and air conditioning systems with a working pressure up to 2500 Pa at the boundary of the street/room or on internal bulkheads and can be used on marine vessels of mixed and inland navigation of all classes, types, and purposes, on gas extraction platforms, floating drilling rigs, stationary marine platforms, civil and industrial construction facilities.
RUZA is an assembly unit consisting of a sequentially connected regulating valve, protective mesh, and louvered grille. The regulating valve of the RUZA external closures consists of a four-sided steel rectangular casing with rotary blades installed on axes in the casing, serving to regulate the air flow during natural ventilation using the RUZA device. The adjustment is only manual using a handle located outside the louvers on the side of the grille installation.

adv: Air flow velocity: at vertical sections no less than 5 m/s, at horizontal sections no less than 7 m/s
Leakage through the closed valve at 300 Pa: 195 l/s·m²
Pressure increase rate: no more than 100 Pa/s
Hydraulic resistance coefficient: no more than 1.5
list.det:
Gravity-operated check valves type KOBRA are designed for local and remote closure of channels in ventilation and air conditioning systems, for cutting off gas-vapor-air flows in ventilation and air conditioning systems with higher than average working pressure. Such valves are used on marine vessels of mixed and inland navigation of all classes, types, and purposes. They are also intended for use on gas extraction platforms, floating drilling rigs, stationary marine platforms, civil and industrial construction facilities.
KOBRA valves consist of a four-sided steel rectangular casing with rotary blades installed on axes with offset to ensure return from the open position by their own weight when the network pressure is relieved. Valve blades with a height of H<400 mm have a sheet-profiled construction without insulation, and with a height of H≥400 mm have a volumetric blade construction without insulation. To ensure smooth operation and the ability to adjust the opening moment, KOBRA valves are equipped with external counterweights.
Depending on the purpose, KOBRA valves can be made of galvanized low-alloy steel or stainless steel.

adv: Actuator mechanism: electric drive or handle

Pressure rise rate: not more than 1000 Pa/s
list.det:
The HEK-type airtight ventilation valve is designed to shut off gas-vapor-air flows in ventilation systems with high operating pressures as a shut-off device for reliably sealing serviced areas from aggressive volumes and spaces containing hazardous or undesirable gas-air technological environments.
Such valves are intended for use on seagoing vessels of all classes, types, and purposes, on gas production platforms, floating drilling rigs, stationary offshore platforms, civil and industrial construction objects of marine river and adjacent coastal infrastructures.
The valve consists of a rectangular cross-section body, a blade, and a lever system.
Channel type valves are made of the following materials:
• thick sheet carbon steel with a gray RAL 7035 coating (design • H)
• stainless steel (design • K).
The valve can be equipped with an adapter (adapters) for connection to air ducts or round section systems. Valves are standardly equipped with reversible type electric drives at 220 V and 380 V, equipped with two auxiliary switches or a manual worm gear mechanism for control. On special order, valves with electric drives, as well as pneumatic drives of other rational types, can be manufactured.

Ceiling air distribution devices with soft and mixing delivery, end element for supply or discharge into the serviced room of the required amount of air. Designed for control and regulation of air flow with accompanying noise reduction function in ventilation, air conditioning, and low and medium pressure air heating systems on seagoing vessels of all classes, types, and purposes. The construction of BRIZ air distributors consists of an inlet box with one or two inlet channels depending on the presence of mixing function and an ejection panel with an adjustment mechanism (depending on the presence of adjustment function). The length of the inlet nozzles does not exceed 100 mm as standard. The adjustment mechanism is a handle for manual control. For the convenience of ceiling mounting of the air distributor, its housing is equipped with four mounting lugs with adjustment slots 10x65 mm.

list.t: Liquid fan coil heat exchanger type KOMPAS-VT
adv: Coolant pressure, MPa: not more than 1.6
Coolant temperature, degrees Celsius: not more than 190
Air operating temperature, degrees Celsius: from 5 to 40 degrees Celsius standard, max - 65 degrees Celsius, clarification when ordering

list.det:
Liquid fan coil heat exchangers (fan coils) of KOMPAS-VT type are designed for creating and maintaining specified temperature parameters in serviced premises of seagoing vessels of all classes, types, and purposes by heating, cooling, and supplying recirculated air. KOMPAS-VT fan coils can also be used on gas production platforms, floating drilling rigs, stationary offshore platforms, civil and industrial construction objects.
The distinctive feature of this type of fan coil is compactness, seismic resistance, resistance to vibration, roll, pitch, natural aggressive environments (sea air, high daily temperature differences), comparative ease of installation, and competitive price.
Fan coils have a block structure, including a fan, heat exchanger, condensate tray, and, as options, water regulating fittings and drainage pump. The construction of fan coils ensures interchangeability of all functional elements and blocks themselves. The main element of the fan coil construction is the housing heat exchanger. The heat exchanger has a welded or soldered construction and meets the strictest requirements for tightness. Heat exchanger tubes can be made of copper, copper-nickel alloy, or stainless steel.
Fan coils use single-sided suction fans. The applied fans are designed for long-term continuous operation, have low power consumption, and a sufficiently low noise level.

adv: Type of coolant: water, oil, water-glycol solution, seawater
Tube/plate material: copper-nickel alloy/copper; stainless steel/copper
Air velocity: not more than 2.65 m/s
list.det:
Tubular-finned heat exchangers are designed for heating or cooling the air passing through their working section, which is ventilated and supplied to the serviced area. These heat exchangers can be used on sea vessels of mixed and inland navigation of all classes, types, and purposes, without restriction on the region of navigation, on gas production platforms, floating drilling rigs, stationary marine platforms, and in civil and industrial construction projects.
Design: Tubular-finned heat exchangers consist of a heat exchange section and a housing. The heat exchange section is one or several rows of tubes with an outer diameter of 5/8'' or 15.87 mm connected by "U-bends". The tubes pass through fins pressed onto them, consisting of corrugated plates made of copper foil with a thickness of 0.16 to 0.40 mm. The ends of the tubes are soldered into collectors made of copper-nickel pipes, through which the energy carrier is supplied and removed.
Operation: The energy carrier is supplied from an external system, for connection to which the heat exchanger collectors' outlets are equipped with flanges for flange connection. In addition, each heat exchanger has its own perforated flanges for embedding into the ventilation duct. Air heating heat exchangers can operate in both direct flow and counterflow. When heating cold air, special measures must be taken to protect against freezing.

adv: Climate design type OM4 or UHL4, atmosphere type II according to GOST 15150
- rolling with an amplitude of 45° and a period of 7-9 s
- short-term (over three minutes) inclination up to 45°
list.det:
KOMPAS-ShSAU automatic control system cabinets are designed for controlling supply, supply-exhaust, central air conditioners with heat/cold recovery, ventilation systems (group of fans), and any other elements of ventilation systems in any combination and operating modes.
Cabinets are individually developed according to customer requirements (project data, ITT, technical specifications, survey sheet, etc.). Cabinets are manufactured according to TU 4862-211-40149153-2015. The application area of the cabinets includes sea and river floating or stationary objects, or coastal infrastructure objects constructed in accordance with RMRS or RKO requirements.
Design: Monoblock type cabinets combine automation and power parts - power circuits, protection circuits, and energy distribution to electrical consumers, control circuits, and instrumentation are located in one housing. The cabinet is equipped with a lockable door with control and indication elements installed on it. The cabinet is powered from a three-phase isolated AC power distribution system (presence of phases L1, L2, L3, neutral is absent) with a frequency of 50 Hz and a voltage of 380 V (400 V), or a single-phase two-wire isolated system (presence of phases L1, L2, neutral is absent), frequency 50 Hz, voltage 220 V (230 V) (IT system ~50 Hz according to GOST 31331.1).

adv: Airflow velocity: not more than 20 m/s
A x B, mm: from 200x400 to 400x600
Length of active part: from 400 to 2500 mm
list.det:
Silencers are designed to reduce noise levels in ventilation and air conditioning systems, suppressing unwanted sound vibrations in predefined frequency spectra, and serving to reduce background noise from active elements of ventilation and air conditioning systems, as well as reducing the impact of reflected noise from air ducts.
Design: The ShKM silencers consist of an active part and connection flanges. The active part of the silencer is a body with walls lined with noise-absorbing material. The connection flanges of the silencer are designed to provide access to all parts of the bolted connection during installation, ensuring its complete mountability in any ventilation system. Grounding units are always provided at the ends of the silencer.
Operation: ShKM silencers can operate in moderately cold or marine climates of the 2nd and 3rd placement categories according to GOST 15150, maintaining operability regardless of spatial orientation in the temperature range from -60 to +50 °C, resistant to vibrational loads, vibration-proof, shock-resistant, and maintaining operability during prolonged heeling, pitching, and rolling. These silencers ensure reliable and stable operation under seismic activity conditions with a maximum calculated earthquake level of 8 points (acceleration 2 m/s2).
The full designated service life of ShKM silencers is 35 years.
